upstream_pr: LLNL/spheral#520 (Bugfixes for Strain-Porosity model and Jaumann rate definition, fixes #534)
build_host: Mac Studio, Apple M5 Max (18 cores), Docker Desktop 29.8.2, Linux VM with 18 CPUs and ~47 GB
spack_target: aarch64 (generic; gcc flags -march=armv8-a -mtune=generic). Detected by Spack, not pinned: the VM reports the Apple CPU as implementer 0x61, part 0x000, which archspec maps to generic aarch64. All 25 Spack-built TPL specs carry target=aarch64 (read from .spack/spec.json, e.g. axom-0.14.0).
spheral_cxx_flags_target: Spheral itself is compiled by /usr/bin/g++ outside Spack's wrapper, with no -march (gcc default armv8-a).
install_prefix: /opt/spheral (real CMake install prefix via host-config-build.py --install-dir; not a symlink). Launcher /opt/spheral/bin/spheral, venv /opt/spheral/.venv.
source_tree: /home/spheral/workspace (git clone at the full SHA, submodules initialised); build tree build_docker-gcc/ kept in the image
recipe: LLNL Dockerfile at 116c71f, unchanged in substance: no arm64 fixes were needed
notes: Spheral starts 18 OpenMP threads per rank when OMP_NUM_THREADS is unset; set it explicitly for timed runs.
Spheral silences print() on MPI ranks other than 0; the 2-rank smoke test confirmed both ranks with os.write and an allreduce.
